availability: local-only; payloads are not downloadable repository/CI artifacts
selection: Immutable publication snapshot of the explicitly listed regular command/input JSON, logs, generated Swift/Python probes/drivers, pre-desktop control manifest and executable snapshots. Original relative paths are preserved in origin. Mutable WORKSTATE and live control manifests, symlinks, checkout/Git/build trees and XCResults are excluded; XCResults remain at their referenced local paths.
treeHashMethod: Sort explicit POSIX relative paths by path components using Unicode code-point order; UTF-8 path, NUL, decimal byte count, NUL, lowercase hexadecimal file SHA-256, trailing LF; concatenate records and SHA-256. Each listed file is regular and not a symlink. No locale sorting or symlink-directory traversal.
